boundaries.allocation: separate Heaptrack-instrumented whole process; interpreted exact allocation events cross-checked against folded totals
boundaries.cgroup: shared runner cgroup; counters are context, not attributed per-probe usage
boundaries.cpu: normal whole-process user plus system rusage, including startup/input/oracles/cleanup; no operation-only CPU claim
boundaries.remaining_allocations: raw live at process exit, without leak suppressions; not an inferred leak finding
boundaries.rss: normal whole-process kernel VmHWM and separately maximum observed RSS; includes input buffers and libraries
boundaries.timing: normal timed operation divided by declared operation count; seven process-level samples in full, not individual-invocation tails
